checks.label: not up two days in a row

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The Y criterion is a hard FAIL — today would be breakout number four of this move, and the chart confirms it: three prior pushes out of the same rising structure are visible, the last of which failed to hold above 850 and rolled back into the current base. Volume on the burst bar is only 29% of the prior session's, the weakest possible confirmation for a dollar-scan entry, and the shaded base itself sits below the August peak cluster where supply is concentrated. The combination of exhausted trend age, overhead supply, and near-absent volume on the signal bar makes this a low-conviction setup regardless of the clean base shape.
claude.key_risk: This is the fourth breakout attempt of a 60-session, 40% move that has already stalled below its August highs, meaning the base sits inside a visible distribution zone with heavy prior volume overhead.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst close of 798 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above 800, as that would confirm the base is breaking down rather than launching.

row.summary: REGN: +1.7% on 0.3× volume out of a base 10.4% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
